title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཡེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 193)
shelf_note: Folio contains classical Pramāṇa (Buddhist epistemology and logic) commentary discussing jāti (futile rejoinders), fitting the Pramāṇa section of the Derge Tengyur (vol. 193 / ye).

pages.prefer_reason: Both translations are exceptionally faithful and accurate, correctly rendering technical Pramāṇa debate terminology and the dialectical nuances of futile rejoinders.

book_verdict: An authentic woodblock folio from the Pramāṇa section of the Derge Tengyur with flawless transcription and two outstanding, faithful English translations of Buddhist logic.
